articles.title: Keeper Login Instructions
articles.summary: How to sign in to the Ericsson Keeper Password Vault using Enterprise SSO.
articles.overview: This guide explains how to log in to the Ericsson Keeper Password Vault through the web using your Ericsson credentials and Enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO).
articles.purpose: Logging in gives you secure access to the passwords and records stored in your Keeper vault.
articles.when_to_use: Use this whenever you need to open your Keeper vault from a browser.
prerequisites: An active Ericsson account.
Approved access to the Ericsson Password Vault. If you have never had access, raise an access request first.
A supported, up-to-date web browser.
steps: Open the Keeper vault login page at https://keepersecurity.eu/vault/#
Enter your Ericsson email ID in the login box.
Select Enterprise SSO Login.
Choose the EU Region.
Click Next and complete any authentication prompts.
You are now logged into the Ericsson Password Vault.
articles.expected_result: Your Keeper vault opens and you can see your stored records and folders.
troubleshooting: If the page does not load, check your internet connection and that the URL is exactly https://keepersecurity.eu/vault/#
If sign-in fails, confirm you selected Enterprise SSO Login and the EU Region.
If you are asked for device approval, see the Admin Approval for New Devices article.
articles.contact_support: If you still cannot sign in after checking the above, contact ericsson.password.vault.support@ericsson.com with your Ericsson email ID, the browser you used, and any error message shown.
security_notes: Never share your Ericsson credentials.
Always confirm the URL is the official https://keepersecurity.eu/vault/# before entering any details.

articles.title: Password Recovery
articles.summary: What to do if you cannot sign in to your Keeper account.
articles.overview: This guide explains how to regain access to Keeper if you cannot sign in. Because Ericsson uses Enterprise SSO, your Keeper access is tied to your Ericsson corporate account.
articles.purpose: Restores your ability to sign in when authentication fails.
articles.when_to_use: Use this if you are unable to log in or your sign-in is being rejected.
prerequisites: An active Ericsson account.
Access to your configured authentication method (for example, your corporate login).
steps: Go to the Keeper vault login page at https://keepersecurity.eu/vault/#
Enter your Ericsson email ID and select Enterprise SSO Login.
Complete the corporate authentication steps when prompted.
If your corporate sign-in itself is failing, recover your Ericsson account through the standard Ericsson IT process. [VERIFY WITH ERICSSON: exact corporate password reset channel]
Once your corporate login works, return to the vault and sign in again.
articles.expected_result: You can authenticate through Enterprise SSO and open your vault.
troubleshooting: If Enterprise SSO rejects you, the issue is usually with the corporate account, not Keeper itself.
Clear your browser cache or try a private window if the login page behaves unexpectedly.
articles.contact_support: If you cannot sign in after recovering your corporate account, contact ericsson.password.vault.support@ericsson.com and describe exactly where the login fails.
security_notes: Keeper support will never ask for your password. Do not share it with anyone.

articles.title: Two-Factor Authentication
articles.summary: Add and use an extra verification step when signing in to Keeper.
articles.overview: Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra verification step when you sign in, so a password alone is not enough to access the vault.
articles.purpose: Protects your vault even if your credentials are compromised.
articles.when_to_use: Use this when setting up 2FA or when you are prompted for a verification code at sign-in.
prerequisites: Access to your Keeper vault.
An authenticator app or the verification method required by your organization. [VERIFY WITH ERICSSON: approved 2FA methods]
steps: Sign in to your vault at https://keepersecurity.eu/vault/#
Follow the configured two-factor authentication method set by your organization.
When prompted at sign-in, enter the one-time verification code from your authenticator.
Complete the sign-in.
articles.expected_result: You complete the extra verification step and your vault opens.
troubleshooting: If your code is rejected, check that your device clock is correct.
If you lost your 2FA device, use your backup recovery codes, then register a new device.
articles.contact_support: If you cannot complete verification and have no recovery codes, contact ericsson.password.vault.support@ericsson.com.
security_notes: Keep your backup recovery codes somewhere safe and private.
Never share verification codes with anyone, including support staff.
